data.one_liner: A rich text WYSIWYG editor component and toolbar for Flutter apps.
data.what_it_does: Provides a rich text editing experience using Quill Delta format for content. Includes customizable toolbars, editors, and block structures supporting modern mobile, web, and desktop platforms.
use_when: You need a full-featured WYSIWYG rich text editor in your Flutter application.
You want to store and manipulate text documents using Quill Delta JSON format.
avoid_when: You only need simple single-line or multi-line plain text inputs.
You want to natively store documents primarily as HTML or Markdown without conversion packages.
strengths: Supports Android, iOS, Web, and desktop platforms.
Extensible embed blocks and toolbar options.
Uses the standard Quill Delta format for rich text representation.
weaknesses: Storing documents directly as HTML requires additional community conversion packages.
Complex setup required on Android for native clipboard image features.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding FlutterQuillLocalizations delegate, localizations config, and optional Android provider configurations for native clipboard image handling.
